items.label: DIY ROCK CLIMBING WALL
items.value: Build your very own rock climbing wall in your backyard! Customize the wall pattern an adjust holds based on preferred difficulty level. Get creative, have fun, and climb on!_x000D_

items.label: KIDS IN ACTION
items.value: Give your children an outlet for all of that extra energy! Climbing helps kids to develop early agility, endurance, strength, balance, flexibility, coordination, and confidence._x000D_

items.label: PLAYGROUND REPLACEMENT OR ADDITION
items.value: Create your own backyard mountain playground! Great for obstacle courses, children's birthday activities & as a jungle gym add on accessory for your outside play set._x000D_

items.label: DETAILS
items.value: 10 rock climbing holds in assorted shapes and colors - 1.5" Bolts, T-Nuts, Washers, instructions & 3/16"Allen wrench. Weather resistant plastic and zinc plated hardware for indoor or outdoor use. Boys & girls age 3 & up.

items.label: MADE WITH YOUR CHILD IN MIND
items.value: Our toys and sporting goods are modernized versions of popular, best selling classics, with improved safety and play functionality. Older kids and adults enjoy them too._x000D_

items.label: Educational Objective
items.value: Develop physical skills through climbing activities
